title: Millable polyurethane/cellulose acetate/nanohydroxyapatite composite film as a flexible ferro-piezoelectric nanogenerator for innovative applications in physiological motion sensing
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,2271-2285
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08584E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Gopika Melepalliyalil, Mekha Mariam Mathew, Soney Varghese, Unnikrishnan Gopalakrishna Panicker
This work examines flexible ferro-piezoelectric composites based on a millable polyurethane and cellulose acetate blend reinforced with nanohydroxyapatite. A prototype device was fabricated, and the output voltage generation was measured.
